description: This file defines the DetailedLeaveRequestMenuConfigurator class, which configures menu items for the leave request view in the OrangeHRM HRM system. It customizes the screen based on request parameters.

classes.name: DetailedLeaveRequestMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Implements menu configuration behavior for detailed leave request screens, switching views based on user request parameters.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Sets the appropriate leave request screen based on request mode ('my-leave' or default). Overrides the module screen accordingly.
